北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 天气有霾，体感 1℃，出门记得戴口罩，多穿点哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Hazy weather, feels like 1℃. Wear a mask and dress warmly when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 15℃。出去走走，享受好天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has lovely sunshine, feels like 15℃. Go for a walk and enjoy the beautiful day!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 14℃，微风舒适。今天是个好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant, feels like 14℃ with a gentle breeze. Have a great day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光灿烂，体感 22℃。天气温暖，注意防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is bright and sunny, feels like 22℃. Warm weather, remember to protect from sun!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 19℃，舒适宜人。多喝水，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is clear and pleasant, feels like 19℃. Drink more water and stay cheerful!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴空万里，体感 16℃。阳光正好，户外活动很棒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has clear skies, feels like 16℃. Perfect for outdoor activities!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴天，体感 14℃，有点干燥。记得多补水哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like 14℃, a bit dry. Remember to hydrate!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴好，体感 13℃。阳光暖暖，正是出游好时光！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is clear and fine, feels like 13℃. Warm sunshine, a great time to go out!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 15℃，温度适中。心情也要像天气一样晴朗！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 15℃, moderate temperature. Keep your spirits bright!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天，体感 11℃，湿度低。注意保暖，多喝水润燥哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 11℃ with low humidity. Stay warm and hydrate to combat dryness!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 13℃。出门请戴口罩，保护好呼吸道！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hazy, feels like 13℃. Please wear a mask when you go out to protect your respiratory system!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -21℃，体感 -27℃，极寒！一定要穿最厚的衣服哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -21℃, feels like -27℃, extremely cold! Make sure to wear your warmest clothes!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳 -11℃，体感 -14℃。虽晴朗，但寒冷，别忘了防寒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is -11℃, feels like -14℃. It's sunny but cold, don't forget to stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 8℃。风力稍大，出门注意防风保暖哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 8℃. The wind is a bit strong, remember to wear windproof and warm clothes!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 18℃，温度适宜。保持好心情，快乐每一天！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 18℃, a comfortable temperature. Stay cheerful and happy every day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 4℃。湿气较重，请注意添衣，保护身体！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy, feels like 4℃ with high humidity. Please add clothes and take care of yourself!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感 -1℃。能见度低，出行务必注意安全！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy, feels like -1℃. Visibility is low, please be extra careful when traveling!
